Single-icon fallback: Globe at 22px, which loses the hexagon.

Google 4-colour 'G' in the Google login button (≈19px). Use Google's official multicolour G SVG. lucide v1 ships no brand icons (lucide-react 1.52 exports no Github or Chrome).
GitHub Invertocat in the GitHub login button, white (≈19px). Use the official GitHub mark SVG with fill currentColor.
User avatar photo (≈34px circle) left of the account chevron. It is a user image with an initials fallback (Avatar component), not an icon.
Solid red rounded squares before 'Your subscriptions' and the 'DOCS' labels. Draw them as CSS boxes, not icons.
Green dot in the 'Active' subscription badges. Draw it as a CSS circle, not an icon.
The '•' separators in 'SECURE • DEPLOY • SCALE' are text characters from the copy, and the login showcase pagination dots are CSS. Neither is an icon.
